title: code.* namespace has no file enumeration; cells bootstrap via tools.glob
wanted_capability: A code.files({ dir?, language? }) binding so fact pipelines are self-contained in the namespace instead of coupling to the glob tool's availability/filter state. Low urgency: glob composed fine in the probe (cost rated "none" by the agent), but a dispatch that filters out glob would strand the namespace.
fallback_used: tools.glob({ pattern: "src/**/*.rs" }) in the first cell.
resolution_note: Both asks shipped: (a) code.files({dir?, language?}) — facts::source_files enumeration (sorted, dot/build-dir skips, MAX_SOURCE_FILES cap with truncated flag); (b) host-side multi-file fan-out — code.items({files}) returns per-file results with per-file error entries, code.query({files}) returns a flat cross-file captures array (spans name their files) + per-file roll-up; all-files-fail collapses to one error. Probe-files-1 (GLM): crate-wide symbol search in 3 turns / 2 cells, code.files → code.query({files}), zero sequential file loops.
